records.label: spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.refresh_api_tooltips#1
records.source: Canonical English prose is retained in ``apiTooltipDescriptionSource``; only the presentation HTML/plain accessibility chrome is regenerated. A label showing why its setting is greyed keeps that reason after the regenerated help (``_LABEL_NOTE_PROPERTY``); before, the language pass dropped it, so a greyed row's name never said why. Field widgets marked ``metadata`` stay quiet because their visible label owns hover help. API-dot destinations carry the selected documentation language while retaining the same module page.
records.context: Canonical English prose is retained in ``apiTooltipDescriptionSource``; only the presentation HTML/plain accessibility chrome is regenerated. A label showing why its setting is greyed keeps that reason after the regenerated help (``_LABEL_NOTE_PROPERTY``); before, the language pass dropped it, so a greyed row's name never said why. Field widgets marked ``metadata`` stay quiet because their visible label owns hover help. API-dot destinations carry the selected documentation language while retaining the same module page.
records.translation: 표준 영어 산문은 ``apiTooltipDescriptionSource`` 에 보관되며, 표시용 HTML/일반 텍스트 접근성 요소만 다시 생성합니다. 설정이 회색으로 표시된 이유를 보여 주는 레이블은 다시 생성된 도움말 뒤에도 그 이유를 유지합니다(``_LABEL_NOTE_PROPERTY``). 예전에는 언어 처리가 이를 버려서, 회색 행의 이름이 이유를 말해 주지 않았습니다. ``metadata`` 로 표시된 필드 위젯은 보이는 레이블이 마우스 올림 도움말을 담당하므로 조용히 둡니다. records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_cellpose#1
records.source: The workbench embeds the ``train_cellpose`` and ``cellpose_masks`` workflows as Train and Apply tabs, each backed by its own :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen`. The Train tab reads ``src`` and ``mask_src`` (default ``<src>/masks``) and writes model checkpoints beneath ``<src>/models``. The Apply tab reads ``<src>/*.tif`` from its independent source directory and writes masks to ``<src>/masks``.
records.context: The workbench embeds the ``train_cellpose`` and ``cellpose_masks`` workflows as Train and Apply tabs, each backed by its own :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen`. The Train tab reads ``src`` and ``mask_src`` (default ``<src>/masks``) and writes model checkpoints beneath ``<src>/models``. The Apply tab reads ``<src>/*.tif`` from its independent source directory and writes masks to ``<src>/masks``.
records.translation: 이 작업대는 ``train_cellpose`` 와 ``cellpose_masks`` 워크플로를 Train 탭과 Apply 탭으로 포함하며, 각각 자체 :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen` 을 가집니다. Train 탭은 ``src`` 와 ``mask_src`` (기본값 ``<src>/masks``)를 읽고 ``<src>/models`` 아래에 모델 체크포인트를 기록합니다. Apply 탭은 독립적인 원본 디렉터리에서 ``<src>/*.tif`` 를 읽고 ``<src>/masks`` 에 마스크를 기록합니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_cellpose.CellposeWorkbenchScreen.trained_checkpoint#1
records.source: Found by looking, not by rebuilding the file name: the training module stamps the architecture and epoch count into what it saves, and a second copy of that formula here would go stale the first time it changed. Everything under the training output folder whose name starts with the model name counts; a finished run's save is preferred over the periodic ones it made on the way, and among equals the most recently written wins.
records.context: Found by looking, not by rebuilding the file name: the training module stamps the architecture and epoch count into what it saves, and a second copy of that formula here would go stale the first time it changed. Everything under the training output folder whose name starts with the model name counts; a finished processing session's save is preferred over the periodic ones it made on the way, and among equals the most recently written wins.
records.translation: 파일 이름을 다시 만들지 않고 찾아서 얻습니다. 학습 모듈은 저장하는 것에 아키텍처와 에포크 수를 새겨 넣으며, 그 공식을 여기에 두 번째로 복사하면 처음 바뀔 때 낡게 됩니다. 학습 출력 폴더 아래에서 이름이 모델 이름으로 시작하는 모든 것이 해당됩니다. 완료된 처리 세션의 저장본이 도중에 만든 주기적 저장본보다 우선하며, 같은 조건이면 가장 최근에 기록된 것이 선택됩니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.settings_search.SettingsSearchBar.reveal#3
records.source: THE DISCLOSURE LEVEL IS CHANGED ONLY IF IT HAS TO BE, AND THE CHANGE IS NEVER REMEMBERED. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.

records.label: spacr.qt.sound#3
records.source: **Nothing exists while sound is off.** The master switch defaults to off, and until somebody turns it on :func:`apply_sound_preferences` returns before constructing anything: no thread, no event filter, no Qt Multimedia import. An application-wide event filter costs every event in the process (measured at 0.93 us per event per filter), so the filter is installed only while a click or hover sound is actually wanted, and removed the moment neither is.
records.context: **Nothing exists while sound is off.** The master switch defaults to off, and until somebody turns it on :func:`apply_sound_preferences` returns before constructing anything: no independent execution path, no event filter, no Qt Multimedia import. records.label: spacr.qt.sound#4
records.source: **Qt Multimedia is touched only on the GUI thread.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` owns ``QMediaDevices`` and every ``QSoundEffect`` and lives where the application's event loop does; the dedicated ``QThread`` keeps the part that is genuinely slow, which is synthesizing a sound set (:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy and file writes, nothing from Qt Multimedia). Connecting to the sound server is slow -- 354 ms measured on a PipeWire workstation -- so it is paid ONCE, on an idle timer after sound is switched on (:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), and logged rather than felt. Playing an already loaded sound is ``play()``, which returns at once: 0.007-0.014 ms on the GUI thread against the real stack.
records.context: **Qt Multimedia is touched only on the main GUI execution path.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` owns ``QMediaDevices`` and every ``QSoundEffect`` and lives where the application's event loop does; the dedicated ``QThread`` keeps the part that is genuinely slow, which is synthesizing a sound set (:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy and file writes, nothing from Qt Multimedia). Connecting to the sound server is slow -- 354 ms measured on a PipeWire workstation -- so it is paid ONCE, on an idle timer after sound is switched on (:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), and logged rather than felt. Playing an already loaded sound is ``play()``, which returns at once: 0.007-0.014 ms on the main GUI execution path against the real stack.
records.translation: **Qt Multimedia 는 GUI 실행 경로에서만 다룹니다.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` 는 ``QMediaDevices`` 와 모든 ``QSoundEffect`` 를 소유하며 애플리케이션의 이벤트 루프가 있는 곳에 있습니다. 전용 ``QThread`` 는 실제로 느린 부분, 즉 사운드 세트 합성(:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy 와 파일 기록, Qt Multimedia 는 사용하지 않음)을 맡습니다. 사운드 서버에 연결하는 것은 느리므로(PipeWire 워크스테이션에서 354 ms 측정), 소리를 켠 뒤 유휴 타이머에서 한 번만 비용을 치르며(:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), 체감되는 대신 로그에 기록됩니다. 이미 로드된 소리를 재생하는 것은 ``play()`` 이며 즉시 반환합니다. 실제 스택에서 GUI 실행 경로에 0.007-0.014 ms 가 걸립니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.sound#5
records.source: This rule is written in a crash. Building the effects on the audio thread instead does move the connection off the GUI thread -- but Qt Multimedia's device handling belongs to the thread that owns the event loop, so with the FFmpeg backend it enables socket notifiers from the wrong thread. Reopening Preferences with sound on then segfaults, or wedges the interface with an empty Preferences frame until it is force quit.
records.context: This rule is written in a crash. Building the effects on the audio independent execution path instead does move the connection off the main GUI execution path -- but Qt Multimedia's device handling belongs to the independent execution path that owns the event loop, so with the FFmpeg backend it enables socket notifiers from the wrong independent execution path. Reopening Preferences with sound on then segfaults, or wedges the interface with an empty Preferences frame until it is force quit.
records.translation: 이 규칙은 충돌 경험에서 나온 것입니다. 효과를 오디오 실행 경로에서 만들면 연결을 GUI 실행 경로 밖으로 옮길 수는 있지만, Qt Multimedia 의 장치 처리는 이벤트 루프를 소유한 실행 경로에 속하므로, FFmpeg 백엔드에서는 잘못된 실행 경로에서 소켓 알리미를 활성화하게 됩니다. 그러면 소리가 켜진 상태에서 Preferences 를 다시 열 때 segfault 가 발생하거나, 강제 종료할 때까지 빈 Preferences 프레임으로 인터페이스가 멈춥니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.sound_synth#2
records.source: The reference theme, :data:`ORBIT`, is melodic space house in A minor: warm detuned-saw pads, plucked arpeggio notes with a dotted-eighth ping-pong delay, a soft sub, a long dark reverb, and — in the music bed alone, never in an interface sound — a quiet four-on-the-floor kick and an eighth-note shaker that come and go with the arrangement. Clicks and hovers are short plucks on notes of the scale, a finished run is an arpeggio rising through the seventh chord into the tonic under a pad swell, and a failed run is a slower falling figure over the minor fourth.
records.context: The reference theme, :data:`ORBIT`, is melodic space house in A minor: warm detuned-saw pads, plucked arpeggio notes with a dotted-eighth ping-pong delay, a soft sub, a long dark reverb, and — in the music bed alone, never in an interface sound — a quiet four-on-the-floor kick and an eighth-note shaker that come and go with the arrangement. Clicks and hovers are short plucks on notes of the scale, a finished processing session is an arpeggio rising through the seventh chord into the tonic under a pad swell, and a failed processing session is a slower falling figure over the minor fourth.
records.translation: 기준 테마인 :data:`ORBIT` 은 A 단조의 선율적인 스페이스 하우스입니다. 따뜻하게 디튠된 톱니파 패드, 부점 팔분음표 핑퐁 딜레이가 걸린 플럭 아르페지오 음, 부드러운 서브 베이스, 길고 어두운 리버브, 그리고 인터페이스 소리가 아닌 음악 배경에서만, 편곡에 따라 들어오고 나가는 조용한 포 온 더 플로어 킥과 팔분음표 셰이커가 있습니다. 클릭과 마우스 올림은 음계 음의 짧은 플럭이고, 완료된 처리 세션은 패드가 부풀어 오르는 가운데 칠화음을 거쳐 으뜸음으로 올라가는 아르페지오이며, 실패한 처리 세션은 단사도 위의 더 느린 하강 음형입니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.sound_synth#3
records.source: This module is Qt-free on purpose. It writes 16-bit PCM WAV files, which is all :class:`PySide6.QtMultimedia.QSoundEffect` needs, into a cache under the spaCR data directory (:func:`sound_cache_root`), one folder per theme and fingerprint so a changed theme or a new synthesiser version can never be answered from a stale file. :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` renders through :func:`ensure_rendered` on its own audio thread and never on the GUI thread.
records.context: This module is Qt-free on purpose. It writes 16-bit PCM WAV files, which is all :class:`PySide6.QtMultimedia.QSoundEffect` needs, into a cache under the spaCR data directory (:func:`sound_cache_root`), one folder per theme and fingerprint so a changed theme or a new synthesiser version can never be answered from a stale file. :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` renders through :func:`ensure_rendered` on its own audio independent execution path and never on the main GUI execution path.
records.translation: 이 모듈은 의도적으로 Qt 에 의존하지 않습니다. :class:`PySide6.QtMultimedia.QSoundEffect` 에 필요한 전부인 16-bit PCM WAV 파일을 spaCR 데이터 디렉터리 아래의 캐시(:func:`sound_cache_root`)에 테마와 지문마다 폴더 하나씩 기록하므로, 바뀐 테마나 새 합성기 버전이 낡은 파일로 응답받는 일은 없습니다. :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` 는 GUI 실행 경로가 아니라 자체 오디오 실행 경로에서 :func:`ensure_rendered` 를 통해 렌더링합니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#5
records.source: ``aurora`` Three overlapping curtains of vertical rays, folding along their own length. The folds are travelling waves — several superposed frequencies running lengthwise along the arc — with brightness surges on a separate schedule, a sharp lower edge, a diffuse top, and the real thing's vertical colour order: green through the body, red high up, a violet fringe underneath. ``ripple`` Concentric rings expanding out of three fixed sources and fading as they grow, like rain on water. Soft-edged, so it never reads as line work. ``drift`` A slow starfield in three parallax layers: small, dim, slow ones behind; bigger, brighter, faster ones in front. The one crisp theme. It travels up, down, or every which way — see :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``bokeh`` Out-of-focus points of light, the way a fluorescence field looks off the focal plane: an aperture image is a *disc with a bright rim*, not a Gaussian smudge, and the ones further out of focus are larger and flatter. ``cells`` Cells drifting through the field, turning as they go — a soft body, a slightly brighter membrane where the edge is seen nearly edge-on, and a distinctly brighter nucleus set off centre. ``resonance`` Sand on a vibrating plate, gathering along the lines that do not move. The only theme with an input other than the clock: while the music bed is playing it is driven by the bed's own precomputed envelope and spectrum (:mod:`spacr.qt.resonance`), and in silence — which is almost everybody, because sound is off on a fresh install — it breathes on its own. See :class:`ResonanceEngine` for why that input is read in :meth:`ResonanceEngine.advance` and nowhere else.
records.context: ``aurora`` Three overlapping curtains of vertical rays, folding along their own length. The folds are travelling waves — several superposed frequencies running lengthwise along the arc — with brightness surges on a separate schedule, a sharp lower edge, a diffuse top, and the real thing's vertical colour order: green through the body, red high up, a violet fringe underneath. ``ripple`` Concentric rings expanding out of three fixed sources and fading as they grow, like rain on water. Soft-edged, so it never reads as line work. ``drift`` A slow starfield in three parallax layers: small, dim, slow ones behind; bigger, brighter, faster ones in front. The one crisp theme. It travels up, down, or every which way — see :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``bokeh`` Out-of-focus points of light, the way a fluorescence field looks off the focal image layer: an aperture image is a *disc with a bright rim*, not a Gaussian smudge, and the ones further out of focus are larger and flatter. ``cells`` Cells drifting through the field, turning as they go — a soft body, a slightly brighter membrane where the edge is seen nearly edge-on, and a distinctly brighter nucleus set off centre. ``resonance`` Sand on a vibrating laboratory microplate, gathering along the lines that do not move. The only theme with an input other than the clock: while the music bed is playing it is driven by the bed's own precomputed envelope and spectrum (:mod:`spacr.qt.resonance`), and in silence — which is almost everybody, because sound is off on a fresh install — it breathes on its own. See :class:`ResonanceEngine` for why that input is read in :meth:`ResonanceEngine.advance` and nowhere else.
records.translation: ``aurora`` 세로 광선으로 된 세 겹의 커튼이 자신의 길이를 따라 접힙니다. 접힘은 진행파 — 호를 따라 길이 방향으로 흐르는 여러 겹친 주파수 — 이며, 별도의 일정으로 밝기가 솟구치고, 아래 가장자리는 선명하고 위쪽은 흐릿하며, 실제 오로라처럼 세로 색 순서를 따릅니다: 몸통은 녹색, 높은 곳은 빨강, 아래쪽은 보라색 테두리. ``ripple`` 고정된 세 원천에서 퍼져 나가며 커질수록 옅어지는 동심원으로, 물 위의 비와 같습니다. 가장자리가 부드러워 선 그림으로 보이지 않습니다. ``drift`` 세 개의 시차 층으로 된 느린 별 무리: 뒤에는 작고 어둡고 느린 별, 앞에는 크고 밝고 빠른 별. 유일하게 선명한 테마입니다. 위로, 아래로, 또는 사방으로 이동합니다 — :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS` 를 참조하십시오. ``bokeh`` 초점이 맞지 않는 빛의 점으로, 형광 현미경 시야가 초점 이미지 레이어를 벗어났을 때의 모습입니다: 조리개 상은 가우시안 번짐이 아니라 *밝은 테두리를 가진 원반* 이며, 초점에서 멀수록 더 크고 평평합니다. ``cells`` 현미경 시야를 떠다니며 회전하는 세포 — 부드러운 몸통, 가장자리가 거의 옆면으로 보이는 곳에서 조금 더 밝은 막, 그리고 중심에서 벗어나 뚜렷하게 더 밝은 핵. ``resonance`` 진동하는 판 위의 모래가 움직이지 않는 선을 따라 모입니다. 시계 외의 입력을 가진 유일한 테마입니다: 배경 음악이 재생되는 동안에는 음악 자체의 미리 계산된 포락선과 스펙트럼(:mod:`spacr.qt.resonance`)으로 구동되고, 무음에서는 — 새로 설치하면 소리가 꺼져 있으므로 거의 모든 사람이 이 경우입니다 — 스스로 호흡합니다. :class:`ResonanceEngine` 을 보면 그 입력을 :meth:`ResonanceEngine.advance` 에서만 읽고 다른 곳에서는 읽지 않는 이유가 나와 있습니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#54
records.source: ``resonance`` is the one row whose contended figure is a range rather than a number, and the shape of its shading is the reason. The others are one long pass of ``QPainter`` calls; the plate is dozens of small NumPy calls, and each one gives the lock back and then queues for it again, so what the cell would measure is how often the shading thread was descheduled rather than how much work the theme does. Four nine-round repeats of the protocol above gave medians of 10, 174, 286 and 407 ms on the same machine. Two things make that liveable and both are already here: the cost is paid on the producer thread, so a late frame is a *repeated* frame (:attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`) and never a slow interface; and while a run is going the process holds :data:`spacr.qt.gil_priority.BUSY_INTERVAL`, where the same measurement is 6 to 24 ms. Its row was taken later than the rest and on a busier machine — ``blobs`` read 0.262 and 0.749 -> 1.002 in the same run — so read it against those rather than against the table.
records.context: ``resonance`` is the one row whose contended figure is a range rather than a number, and the shape of its shading is the reason. The others are one long pass of ``QPainter`` calls; the laboratory microplate is dozens of small NumPy calls, and each one gives the lock back and then software job lists for it again, so what the cell would measure is how often the shading independent execution path was descheduled rather than how much work the theme does. Four nine-round repeats of the protocol above gave medians of 10, 174, 286 and 407 ms on the same machine. Two things make that liveable and both are already here: the cost is paid on the producer independent execution path, so a late frame is a *repeated* frame (:attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`) and never a slow interface; and while a processing session is going the process holds :data:`spacr.qt.gil_priority.BUSY_INTERVAL`, where the same measurement is 6 to 24 ms. Its row was taken later than the rest and on a busier machine — ``blobs`` read 0.262 and 0.749 -> 1.002 in the same processing session — so read it against those rather than against the table.
records.translation: ``resonance`` 는 경합 수치가 숫자가 아니라 범위인 유일한 행이며, 그 이유는 셰이딩 방식에 있습니다. 다른 테마는 ``QPainter`` 호출을 한 번 길게 처리하지만, 판은 작은 NumPy 호출 수십 개이고 각 호출이 잠금을 돌려준 뒤 다시 대기열에 서므로, 셀이 측정하게 되는 것은 테마가 하는 작업량이 아니라 셰이딩 스레드가 얼마나 자주 스케줄에서 밀려났는지입니다. 위 프로토콜을 아홉 회차씩 네 번 반복하자 같은 컴퓨터에서 중앙값이 10, 174, 286, 407 ms 로 나왔습니다. 이를 감당할 만하게 만드는 두 가지가 이미 여기 있습니다: 비용은 생산자 스레드에서 치르므로 늦은 프레임은 느린 인터페이스가 아니라 *반복된* 프레임(:attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`)이 되며, 처리 세션이 진행 중일 때는 프로세스가 :data:`spacr.qt.gil_priority.BUSY_INTERVAL` 을 유지하는데 이때 같은 측정값은 6 에서 24 ms 입니다. 이 행은 나머지보다 나중에 더 바쁜 컴퓨터에서 측정되었으므로 — 같은 처리 세션에서 ``blobs`` 는 0.262 와 0.749 -> 1.002 였습니다 — 표가 아니라 그 값들과 비교해 읽으십시오.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.ResonanceEngine#1
records.source: A floor with particles on it, and the particles are sand on a vibrating plate. The physics is in :mod:`spacr.qt.resonance` and is worth one paragraph here because it is what makes this theme different from a particle system with a music-shaped wobble: a plate driven at one of its resonances has lines that do not move, sand is thrown off everywhere else and comes to rest along them, and the figure IS the nodal set. So there is a right answer for where a particle goes, and the drive decides which figure it is and how hard the sand is being shaken rather than deciding the motion directly.

records.source: WHY THE DRIVE IS READ IN :meth:`advance` AND NOT WHERE IT IS USED. Every other engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)``, and two tests hold it down: one shades the same clock on two threads and compares the bytes, another steps one engine twelve times and jumps a second straight to the same clock. Reading a real-time signal inside :meth:`shade` would break both, and it would break them on the SHADING THREAD, where the failure is a picture that differs from the one the GUI thread would have drawn. So the drive is an INPUT, set on the GUI thread between frames under the engine lock exactly as :meth:`set_palette` is, and the promise becomes "a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size, drive)``" -- which is the same promise while nothing is playing, and that is when the tests run.
records.context: Why the drive is read in :meth:`advance` and not WHERE it is used. Every other engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)``, and two tests hold it down: one shades the same clock on two independent execution paths and compares the bytes, another steps one engine twelve times and jumps a second straight to the same clock. Reading a real-time signal inside :meth:`shade` would break both, and it would break them on the shading independent execution path, where the failure is a picture that differs from the one the main GUI execution path would have drawn. So the drive is an INPUT, set on the main GUI execution path between frames under the engine lock exactly as :meth:`set_palette` is, and the promise becomes "a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size, drive)``" -- which is the same promise while nothing is playing, and that is when the tests run.
records.translation: 구동을 사용되는 곳(WHERE)이 아니라 :meth:`advance` 에서 읽는 이유. 다른 모든 엔진은 프레임이 ``(seed, clock, size)`` 의 순수 함수라고 약속하며, 두 테스트가 이를 지킵니다: 하나는 같은 시계를 두 스레드에서 셰이딩해 바이트를 비교하고, 다른 하나는 엔진 하나를 열두 번 진행시키고 두 번째 엔진을 같은 시계로 곧장 건너뛰게 합니다. :meth:`shade` 안에서 실시간 신호를 읽으면 둘 다 깨지며, 그것도 셰이딩 스레드에서 깨지는데, 그곳에서의 실패는 GUI 실행 경로가 그렸을 그림과 다른 그림으로 나타납니다. 그래서 구동은 입력으로, :meth:`set_palette` 와 똑같이 엔진 잠금 아래 프레임 사이에 GUI 실행 경로에서 설정되며, 약속은 "``(seed, clock, size, drive)`` 의 순수 함수" 가 됩니다 -- 아무것도 재생되지 않는 동안에는 같은 약속이며, 테스트는 바로 그때 실행됩니다.

records.source: THE CLOCK IS NOT THE WHOLE ANIMATION HERE, WHICH IS WHY THIS EXISTS. :meth:`AmbientEngine.advance` multiplies ``dt`` by :attr:`speed`, and that is the whole of the Speed preference for every other theme, because every other theme's motion is a function of the clock alone. Half of this one is a function of the music instead: the throw on an onset, the per-band brightness and the figure the spectrum's centre of mass asks for. At the bottom of :data:`SPEED_RANGE` the breath, the mode walk and the wander all crawl at a tenth, and a kick would still have thrown the sand :data:`RESONANCE_THROW` of the plate twice a second -- leaving the busiest movement in the theme running at full rate for somebody who set the slider to its minimum precisely to stop that.

Half of this one is a function of the music instead: the throw on an onset, the per-band brightness and the figure the spectrum's centre of mass asks for. At the bottom of :data:`SPEED_RANGE` the breath, the mode walk and the wander all crawl at a tenth, and a kick would still have thrown the sand :data:`RESONANCE_THROW` of the plate twice a second -- leaving the busiest movement in the theme running at full rate for somebody who set the slider to its minimum precisely to stop that.
records.translation: 여기서는 시계가 애니메이션의 전부가 아니며, 그래서 이 함수가 존재합니다. :meth:`AmbientEngine.advance` 는 ``dt`` 에 :attr:`speed` 를 곱하며, 다른 모든 테마의 움직임은 시계만의 함수이므로 그것이 다른 모든 테마에 대한 Speed 환경 설정의 전부입니다. 이 테마의 절반은 대신 음악의 함수입니다: 시작 충격에 따른 튕김, 대역별 밝기, 스펙트럼 무게 중심이 요구하는 도형. :data:`SPEED_RANGE` 의 최솟값에서는 호흡, 모드 이동, 떠돌기가 모두 십분의 일 속도로 기어가는데, 킥은 여전히 모래를 초당 두 번 판의 :data:`RESONANCE_THROW` 만큼 튕겨 냈을 것입니다 -- 바로 그것을 멈추려고 슬라이더를 최소로 둔 사람에게 테마에서 가장 분주한 움직임을 최대 속도로 남겨 두는 셈입니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.collapsible_splitter#1
records.source: Item 471, slice B. Two requests that turn out to be one: every container collapses ("whenever anything is collapsed it should auto lock to the bottom of the container it is in"), and every container can be "expanded or shrinkable by draging the edges". A :class:`~PySide6.QtWidgets.QSplitter` already does both -- a handle to drag, and a child that can be taken down to nothing -- so both halves live here as ONE mechanism, and anything that collapses in a splitter also resizes, and the other way round.
records.context: Item 471, slice B. Two requests that turn out to be one: every container collapses ("whenever anything is collapsed it should auto lock to the bottom of the container it is in"), and every container can be "expanded or shrinkable by draging the edges". A :class:`~PySide6.QtWidgets.QSplitter` already does both -- a handle to drag, and a child that can be taken down to nothing -- so both halves live here as ONE mechanism, and anything that collapses in a splitter also resizes, and the other way round.
records.translation: 항목 471, 슬라이스 B. 결국 하나로 밝혀진 두 요청입니다: 모든 컨테이너는 접힌다("무엇이든 접히면 그것이 들어 있는 컨테이너의 맨 아래에 자동으로 고정되어야 한다"), 그리고 모든 컨테이너는 "가장자리를 끌어 늘리거나 줄일 수 있어야" 한다. :class:`~PySide6.QtWidgets.QSplitter` 는 이미 둘 다 합니다 -- 끌 손잡이, 그리고 아무것도 없을 때까지 줄일 수 있는 자식 -- 그래서 두 절반이 여기서 반드시 하나의 메커니즘으로 존재하며, 분할기에서 접히는 모든 것은 크기도 조정되고 그 반대도 마찬가지입니다.

records.source: :class:`FocusCollapse` The automatic half. Some widgets are FOCUS widgets (a live preview, the figures panel): while any of them is on screen, the TARGET panes collapse (console, System, the buttons, the settings column), and when the last one goes they come back. records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.collapsible_splitter.FocusCollapse#4
records.source: A VIEW is one visit to one screen: it begins when the screen is shown (:meth:`begin_view`, from its ``showEvent``) and ends when it is hidden because the user went to another screen (:meth:`end_view`, from its ``hideEvent``). Minimising the window does not end it -- the owner passes only non-spontaneous events. Pins last for the view: returning to the screen with its live preview still open collapses the surroundings again, which is what a fresh arrival at that layout would get.
records.context: A view is one visit to one application view: it begins when the application view is shown (:meth:`begin_view`, from its ``showEvent``) and ends when it is hidden because the user went to another application view (:meth:`end_view`, from its ``hideEvent``). Minimising the window does not end it -- the owner passes only non-spontaneous events. Pins last for the view: returning to the application view with its live preview still open collapses the surroundings again, which is what a fresh arrival at that layout would get.
records.translation: 보기란 한 화면을 한 번 방문하는 것입니다: 화면이 표시되면 시작하고(:meth:`begin_view`, 그 ``showEvent`` 에서), 사용자가 다른 화면으로 가서 숨겨지면 끝납니다(:meth:`end_view`, 그 ``hideEvent`` 에서). 창을 최소화해도 끝나지 않습니다 -- 소유자는 자발적이지 않은 이벤트만 전달합니다. 고정은 보기 동안 유지됩니다: 실시간 미리 보기가 열린 채로 화면에 돌아오면 주변이 다시 접히며, 이는 그 배치에 새로 도착했을 때와 같습니다.
